title: Smooth bomber rotation — visual root.rotation.y lerps to target over 120ms instead of snapping
intent: S108 shipped 'bomber root faces walk direction' as an instant snap — when GridMover's direction changes, root.rotation.y aligns immediately. The snap reads as robotic and undercuts the slapstick / toy-scale identity (visual-style.md §2). Smoothing the rotation as a 120ms angular lerp gives bombers a natural 'turn-toward' feel without breaking gameplay. Critical separation: the LOGICAL direction (used by bomb-placement IK arm-pick, blast direction propagation, GridMover) changes IMMEDIATELY on input — only the VISUAL Transform.rotation.y interpolates. Gameplay state and physics are unchanged; only the rendered mesh tweens.
rationale: Source: user feedback 2026-05-27 — 'человечки поворачиваться должны чуть анимировано а не резко менять направление'. Single-line readability win that doesn't touch gameplay logic. Pairs well with the procedural-character + walk-cycle + dash work — smooth rotation makes the character feel like it INHABITS the world rather than being teleported between facings. Marked `could` because the snap is functional; this is pure polish. Cheap to ship (one rotation lerp system); pairs nicely with the dash story (GDP-2026-05-27-014) since dash's arc + rotation smoothing land in the same animation pass.
acceptanceHints: examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
BomberFacing component (per bomber): { targetRotationY: number, currentRotationY: number, lerpDurationMs: number (default 120) }
GridMover writes targetRotationY whenever direction changes (existing direction-write path gets one extra line).
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomber-rotation-smoothing-system.ts: NEW.
Runs every fixedUpdate AFTER GridMover (which updates targetRotationY) but BEFORE the render-side animation pipeline.

For each entity with BomberFacing: lerp currentRotationY toward targetRotationY at rate (targetRotationY - currentRotationY) / (lerpDurationMs / dt). Use SHORTEST ANGULAR PATH — don't take the long way around 360°.
Write currentRotationY to Transform.rotation.y.
SHORTEST-PATH ANGULAR LERP:
Standard angular lerp: delta = target - current; if delta > π, delta -= 2π; if delta < -π, delta += 2π. Apply delta × (dt / lerpDurationMs).

Edge case: bomber walks east (0°) then south (90°) — interpolates clockwise. Then west (180°) — keeps clockwise direction → 180° interpolation. Then east (0°) — should take the SHORT path counter-clockwise back to 0°, NOT clockwise through 270°. Test this explicitly.
Edge case: bomber walks east (0°) then turns west (180°) — exactly opposite direction; either CW or CCW is valid. Pick CW (positive direction) deterministically for replay-safety.
LOGICAL DIRECTION SEPARATION:
GridMover.queuedDirection + GridMover.currentDx/Dz — change IMMEDIATELY on input. These drive gameplay.
Transform.rotation.y — interpolates. This drives rendering ONLY.

Bomb-placement IK arm-pick (S104 KABOOM-REACH-IK-PLACE-BOMB): currently uses bomber's FACING (Transform.rotation.y derived) to pick which arm reaches. After this story: uses LOGICAL direction from GridMover (not Transform.rotation.y) so arm-pick is instant + accurate even during the rotation lerp.
Dash direction (GDP-2026-05-27-014): same — logical from GridMover, visual lerp from BomberFacing.
Blast direction for ragdoll impulse: uses blast origin → bomber cell, NOT facing direction. Unaffected.
INTERACTIONS:

Death tween: when ragdoll spawns (GDP-2026-05-22-005 / S129+), it takes over the bomber's root Transform. Rotation smoothing system should NOT compete — exit early when BomberStats.alive=false (or when RagdollState is present on the root). Standard 'animation systems back off during ragdoll' rule.
Idle / walk / hit-recoil / dash animations: all operate on CHILD pivots (shoulder, hip, etc.) of the bomber root. They don't touch root.rotation.y, so they coexist with rotation smoothing.

Multiplayer: the remote-bomber-interpolator-system already interpolates Transform.position smoothly between snapshots. After this story, it ALSO interpolates Transform.rotation.y between snapshots (small change). Local-player path uses the rotation-smoothing-system; remote-player path uses snapshot interpolation. Both produce smooth rotation; the source differs by tab.
RECIPE / PER-BOMBER TUNING:

recipe.locomotion (NEW optional block) — gains a `rotationLerpDurationMs?: number` field (clamped 50..300, default 120). Allows per-bomber tuning — e.g. nimble bots could have 80ms (fast turn); heavy bots could have 200ms (slow turn). Initial v1: same value for everyone; per-recipe tuning is the forward hook.
Bot personality variants from S139 could later use this — Hunter has faster rotation than Coward. Stretch for follow-up.
PERFORMANCE: one lerp per bomber per fixedUpdate. 4 bombers × 60 ticks = 240 lerps/sec. Negligible.
UNIT TESTS:
currentRotationY = 0, targetRotationY = π/2 → after 120ms (6 fixedUpdate ticks at 60Hz), currentRotationY ≈ π/2 (within float epsilon).
currentRotationY = 0, targetRotationY = 3π/2 → shortest path is -π/2 (counter-clockwise). After 120ms, currentRotationY ≈ -π/2 (or equivalently 3π/2 modular).
Rapid direction reversal: target was π/2, current at π/4 mid-lerp, new target -π/2 → smoothing continues from current toward new target via shortest path (no snap).
Death (BomberStats.alive=false) → rotation smoothing stops; Transform.rotation.y holds at last value (ragdoll takes over next tick).
Bomb-placement IK arm-pick uses logical direction, NOT Transform.rotation.y → arm-pick is instant + correct during the rotation lerp.
PLAYTEST QA BAR:
Walk forward + immediately turn left → bomber visibly arcs the turn over ~120ms instead of snapping.
Rapid input chain (forward → left → right → back) → smooth chain of arcs, no jitter, never spins the long way around.
Bomb placement on the turn: bomb spawns instantly at the bomber's grid cell (logical position; not affected by visual lerp).
OUT OF SCOPE:
Pitch / roll smoothing — only Y-axis (yaw / facing) is animated. Pitch/roll for ragdoll death are physics-driven.
Anticipation animation (bomber leans into the turn before rotating). Stretch polish; not in v1.
Per-direction smoothing curve (ease-in-out vs linear). Linear in v1 — feels predictable. Curve tuning if playtest wants.
Bot-personality-tuned rotation speed (Hunter fast / Coward slow). Forward hook in recipe.locomotion but not implemented in v1.
Snapping back to N/S/E/W cardinal on standing still — bombers KEEP their last-walked facing per S108 (already shipped). This story doesn't change that.
Rotation smoothing during dash arc (GDP-2026-05-27-014). Dash's facing is locked for the dash duration; rotation smoothing resumes after the dash lands.
